pairs.question: Quem primum hasta, aut quem postremum bellica virgo demetis, aut quot humi candentia corpora linquis?
pairs.answer: Semianimes volvuntur equi niveique, nigrique, et peditum cunei, dilectaque pectora Marti aligera juvenes ineuntes bella sagitta.
pairs.derivation: The narrator apostrophizes the warrior-maiden (Amazon) with a genuine interrogative (quem... quem... quot...) at 370-371, ending at the question mark. He answers it himself, enumerating the slain she leaves on the ground, beginning at 372 'Semianimes volvuntur...'. The answer window ends at 374 'sagitta.', the last word before line 375 begins a new, separate rhetorical question ('Quis cladem fando illius...') which is the inexpressibility topos and is not answered. No scaffolding artifacts fall within the span.
